description:
Cast Bill the Pony by paying {3}{W}.
When Bill the Pony enters the battlefield, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food, a Clue and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bill the Pony trigger, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bill the Pony, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Bill the Pony to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.
